title: D4 signal-only herald BP threshold validation
question: On the paper D4 red-X channel with only public e_B/e_G herald signals, do matched O0, O2, and BP-MWPM flux LER curves cross near the published 0.20--0.22 region?
gates: Use only the signal-only binary e-charge record: zero must not reveal hidden degree-two fusion support.
Count every attempted trajectory in the paper LER denominator; a physical winding is already a logical failure.
Require source-normalized L=5,7,9,11,13, p_Z=0, matched physical/observation seeds, and 1000 attempts per cell before any finite-size interpretation.
Do not compare this signal-only campaign to the withdrawn support-revealing BP curves except as an implementation-remediation diagnostic.

noise_model.observation_record: binary signal-only e_B/e_G; no measurement-support label

scan_design.stage_2_selection_rule: After the fresh 1000-attempt grid, add matched 1000-history increments only to adjacent-size risk-difference intervals containing zero and their immediate p neighbors.

launch_guard.reason: The coloured q=1/2 event table and signal-only record remediation must be verified before fresh allocation.

claim_boundary: This is a paper-compatible first-stage flux-LER campaign. It is not the full two-stage D4 threshold and cannot promote a BP threshold until the source-likelihood gate and stable multi-L finite-size evidence pass.

stage_1_evidence.selection_reason: At least one preregistered decoder/adjacent-size 90% risk-difference interval remains unresolved at every grid point after immediate-neighbor expansion.

stage_2_evidence.selection_reason: The same registered decoder/adjacent-size 90% interval union plus neighbor expansion still selects every grid cell; BP is directionally ordered at p_X=0.19 but larger-size intervals remain unresolved at p_X=0.20--0.22.

stage_3_evidence.selection_reason: The registered union-plus-neighbor rule still selects every cell. BP resolves negative L=5-to-7 differences at p_X=0.20 and 0.21 and three larger-size differences at p_X=0.19, but most p_X=0.20--0.22 larger-size intervals remain unresolved.

stage_4_evidence.selection_reason: The registered decoder-union plus immediate-neighbor rule still selects all 20 cells. BP has five resolved negative adjacent-size directions, but 11 of 16 BP intervals remain unresolved, including every interval at p_X=0.21 and 0.22.

stage_5_evidence.selection_reason: At the registered cap, BP has six resolved negative adjacent-size directions and ten unresolved intervals; every interval at p_X=0.21 and 0.22 remains unresolved. The frozen rule would retain 19 cells, but the cap ends allocation.
stage_5_evidence.decision: Close the corrected first-stage finite-size campaign without a crossing fit or threshold estimate.
